name: keys-broker
summary: Policy-mediated, human-gateable A2A surface over the deterministic FuzeKeys secret-broker. The thin agent surface; all authz/lifecycle stays in the deterministic core (backend/app/broker).
_note: Serving role scaffold. The broker CORE is deterministic security infra (not an LLM). This role only mediates the human-gated path (reach_human for high-value grants). Card projection must be validated by a2a-maintainer against the frozen contracts/a2a/v1 (owned elsewhere) before enabled:true.

skills.name: Issue grant
skills.description: Issue an opaque, TTL-bound, single-use grant handle bound to a redeemer transport identity. Returns no secret material.

skills.name: Redeem grant
skills.description: Redeem a grant handle as the caller's authenticated transport identity; releases a short-lived derived credential. High-sensitivity grants require human approval (reach_human) before release.

skills.name: Token exchange (RFC 8693)
skills.description: Exchange the caller's own identity token for a scoped, short-TTL downstream token. The secretless ideal — no stored secret shared.

skills.name: Revoke grant
skills.description: Instantly revoke a grant by id. Idempotent and non-disclosing.

release_tiers.high: human approval required (reach_human / digital-persona) before release

policy.identity: authorization is ALWAYS on the authenticated transport identity (OIDC repo claim / mTLS-SPIFFE), never a caller-asserted identity. A permission is rollout convenience only and never replaces the real check.
policy.audit: every grant/redeem/mint/revoke is audited (requester, redeemer, scope, time) — never the secret value.

oidc.description: GitHub Actions / FuzeOne OIDC; the verified `repo` claim is the transport identity.

mtls.description: SPIFFE-style workload cert; the peer subject is the transport identity.

recipientKey.description: Published JWK for envelope encryption (KMS wrap-unwrap) so a secret can transit an untrusted relay encrypted to this broker's recipients only.
